methodology: Verify every candidate against an official club or league current-squad, retained-list, contract or confirmed-transfer source before evaluating penalty evidence.
Reject rumours and exclude officially departed players at the audit cutoff.
Prioritise 2026 preseason and 2025/26 competitive in-match penalties, especially same-pitch ordering and absence substitutions.
Use official reports and statements first, then set-piece specialists and credible local reporting; use historical career logs only as fallback.
Keep shootout evidence separate from regular-time assignments and label shootout-only uncertainty explicitly.
Assign confidence per position and provisional or conditional status when the complete order has not been directly observed.
